meta.title: Replace CLI subprocess approach with Claude Code SDK
meta.body_summary: Replace CLI subprocess execution with Claude Code SDK for better performance, type safety, and error handling while maintaining the same interface.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced CLI subprocess spawning in backend/main.ts with Claude Code SDK query() function, maintaining identical interface and JSON output. Added deno.lock dependency for npm:@anthropic-ai/claude-code, --allow-env permissions in deno.json and release workflow.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Permission and workflow changes are minimal side effects of SDK integration.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: SDK integration with feature flag and CLI fallback.
Simplify: remove fallback and feature flag for clean SDK-only approach.
Add --allow-env to deno.json for SDK environment access.
Add --allow-env to release workflow for binary compilation.
Final commit: refine SDK usage with dynamic path resolution via 'which claude'.
